files.purpose_guess: Current-year (2026) seed sowing list: a pre-populated species list with projected potting numbers and pricking-tray counts, only partly filled in with stratification, sowing and collection details.

sheets.name: Sheet1
sheets.grain: One species per row for the 2026 sowing season: projected potting number, pricking trays needed, and (for about 10 species) seed-lot, stratification, sowing and collection details. The profiler guessed header row 19; the real header is row 2.

columns.notes: 55 species in A3:A57, alphabetical. No common or Māori names. Row 41 has stray text ('Ozothamnus vauvilliersii  )'); row 47 has a non-breaking space ('Plagianthus  regius').

Plants projected for potting. Stored as floats (96.0). Sum of B3:B57 is 10,980. Year the projection is for is not stated in the header (2025 file says 2026-27; 2024 file says 2025/2026). Mostly multiples of 24, except rows 5, 6, 18, 43, 44 (fast/T28 species) and a few others.

Number of pricking trays (a bare number; container type is not stated, unlike 2025 where it reads '4 V150'). Mostly equals B/24 rounded (V150 = 24 plants per tray, inferred, medium confidence). Four rows break this: C5 (196 -> 7), C6 (616 -> 22), C11 (192 -> 6), C15 (192 -> 10). Blank for Cordyline australis, Phormium cookianum and Phormium tenax (rows 18, 43, 44), which are fast species.
SENSITIVE. Free text combining a seed quantity (e.g. '1 tsp') with an abbreviated collection-site name. Filled in 10 of 55 rows. Values withheld.
Text dates in d.m.yy format mixed with vague entries. E19 reads '1.6.26 (2months)'. Several dates (30.7.26) look like planned or recent dates rather than events.
Only 3 rows filled (F19, F24, F46), all 19.8.26. Text d.m.yy.
Sowing container (germination tray, Stage 1). Same 3 rows as column F.
Seed collection date as text d.m.yy. H46 is 1.7.25, a year earlier than the rest.
Seed-lot label (S-number). Only 2 rows filled. This column is new in 2026; in 2024 and 2025 the S-numbers sit in the Notes column.

examples: Soaked for 5 days. Janola bath. Cold moist strat in sphagnum moss
columns.notes: Free-text treatment notes. J5 and J6 hold 'T28' (the container marker is put in Notes here, not in the tray column). J49 notes warm then cold storage.

files.path: 2. Propagation (cuttings and seeds)/_Seed and Cutting Records/Seed Sowing /1. Seed Sowing 2025.xlsx
files.purpose_guess: 2025 seed sowing list: species sown in winter 2025 with their seed source, stratification, sowing and collection dates, and the projected potting number for the 2026-27 production year.

sheets.name: Sheet1
sheets.grain: One species per row for the 2025 sowing: seed sown and source, stratification date, sowing date, tray size, collection date, label number in notes, and projected potting for 2026-27. Rows 62-65 sit below an 'EXTRAS' marker.

columns.notes: 62 non-blank cells in A3:A65, including the word EXTRAS (one row) and four unlisted extras beneath it (Streblus het, Parsonsia, Eleocarpus, Cop rham: abbreviated or genus-only). Red font on 7 cells (A5, A6, A18, A34, A44, A45, A48), mostly fast/T28 species, meaning not documented.
Plants projected for potting in 2026-27, numeric. Sum of B3:B65 is 11,121; stated total in B66 is 11,120 (hard-coded).
Text combining a tray count with the container (V150 or T28). The count is blended with the unit, so needs parsing. Leading spaces and a missing space ('8T28') occur.
SENSITIVE. Free text: seed quantity (tsp, Tbsp, cup fractions) plus abbreviated seed-source location. About 40 rows filled. Values withheld.
Text d.m.yy dates mixed with yes/no and treatment words. One entry '24.7.24' is probably a typo for 2025 (medium confidence).
Sowing date as text. 35 rows share 13.8.25 (one sowing day); F-column has one outlier 13.6.25.
Fraction or count of a sowing container (V150 or Hygiene tray), as text. 'Hygiene' and 'V150' both used for the germination stage. Spacing inconsistent ('1Hygiene').
Seed collection date as text d.m.yy. Some are from 2024, i.e. stored seed.
Mixes seed label numbers (S-numbers, which link to the Seed collecting and Seed records) with status words (seedlings, cuttings, no seed yet). Seed lot code and notes share one column.

open_questions_for_wrt: Is Seed Sowing 2026 .xlsx the live file for the current year, and which year does its 'Projected potting' column refer to (2027-28?)? Why does it list only 55 species and have no source or date detail for most?

Which 2025 version is the master: '1. Seed Sowing 2025.xlsx' or the version in 'latest from Helen' (which has the extra 20.8.25 sowings and label numbers S298 to S305)? Should the other be treated as superseded?
'Seed Sowing 2026 To be updated.xlsx' in the archive is identical to the 2025 list. Was a blank 2026 template meant to be there?
What does red font on species names mean in the 2024 and 2025 lists (T28 species only, or something else)? Why is Pittosporum eugenioides or Olearia avicenniifolia also red?
How are pricking trays worked out from the projected potting number (24 plants per V150 tray?), and why do four species in 2026 differ from that rule?
Is the 2025 'Projected potting 2026-27' the same number as the target in the Production planning and Pricking out list? Which one is the source of truth?
Should species marked 0 in the 2024 projection (27 species) still count in the 93 to 98 species total, and are the 'EXTRAS' (Streblus, Parsonsia, Eleocarpus, Cop rham) in production?

Do S-numbers in the Notes column and the 2026 'Label number' column match the Seed collecting record and Seed records, and is there one master list of seed lots with their collection details? (Seed-source locations are held only in free-text columns, so how should these be handled when the data is brought together?)
Does a blank in the sowing columns mean 'cutting' or 'not yet sown' or 'bought in'? The 2025 notes use 'cuttings', 'seedlings', 'no seed yet' to cover this.
